info.name: HustleHub+ API (Part 2)
info.description: Automated API tests for HustleHub+: authentication, gigs, bookings, transactions, RBAC, validation, sanitisation, security headers and rate limiting. Run with `npm test` (Newman) or import into Postman and run the collection in order.

item.name: 00 - Setup and security headers
item.description: Starts a fresh run and checks the API is reachable over HTTPS with security headers.

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Registration, login and token handling, including attack attempts.

exec: pm.test('Message is safe and informative', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/already exists/i));

pm.test('Error names the "password" field', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors.map(e => e.field)).to.include('password'));
pm.test('Error names the "email" field', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors.map(e => e.field)).to.include('email'));

item.name: Gig is unchanged after the blocked attempts
03 - Bookings (and their transactions)
item.description: Clients book gigs. Every booking creates a transaction. Users only see their own records.

exec: pm.test('Error names the "gigId" field', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors.map(e => e.field)).to.include('gigId'));

item.name: Client A books the gig and a transaction is created (201)

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; const price = pm.collectionVariables.get('gigPrice');
pm.test('Booking price comes from the gig, not the request', () => pm.expect(d.booking.price).to.eql(price));
pm.test('Transaction amount equals the gig price', () => pm.expect(d.transaction.amount).to.eql(price));
pm.test('Transaction is linked to the booking', () => pm.expect(d.transaction.booking).to.eql(d.booking.id));
pm.test('Transaction has a reference and ZAR currency', () => { pm.expect(d.transaction.reference).to.match(/^TXN-[0-9A-F]{10}$/); pm.expect(d.transaction.currency).to.eql('ZAR'); });
pm.test('HTML was stripped from the notes', () => pm.expect(d.booking.notes).to.eql('Please use blue tones.'));

item.name: Client A lists bookings and sees it (200)
Freelancer A sees the booking they received (200)
Freelancer B does not see it (200, empty)
Client B cannot read client A booking (404)
Freelancer B cannot read the booking (404)
Client cannot mark a booking completed (403)
04 - Transactions and income tracking
item.description: Payments are visible to their parties; income is tracked per freelancer.

item.name: Client B sees no payments (200, empty)

exec: pm.test('Another user\'s payment is hidden', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(t => t.reference)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('txnRef')));
const d = pm.response.json().data; const price = pm.collectionVariables.get('gigPrice'); const r2 = (n) => Math.round((n + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
pm.test('Total income equals the booked gig price', () => pm.expect(d.totalIncome).to.eql(price));
pm.test('Estimated tax = income x rate', () => pm.expect(d.estimatedTax).to.eql(r2(d.totalIncome * d.estimatedTaxRate)));
pm.test('Breakdown by gig is included', () => { pm.expect(d.byGig).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(d.byGig[0].income).to.eql(price); pm.expect(d.byGig[0].bookings).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('At least the users from this run exist', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.length).to.be.at.least(5));
pm.test('No password data in the list', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/password|"hash"|\$2[aby]\$/i));

item.name: Admin removes a gig for moderation (200)
06 - Rate limiting: bookings
item.description: Each client may make 5 bookings per 10 minutes. The 6th is refused with a clear message.

item.name: Client B booking 6 is rate limited (429)

exec: pm.test('Message is safe and informative', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/too quickly/i));
pm.test('Tells the client how long to wait', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().retryAfterSeconds).to.be.a('number').and.above(0));

item.name: Client A is unaffected - limits are per user (201)
07 - History survives gig deletion
item.description: Bookings and income keep their record even when the gig is removed.

item.name: Freelancer A deletes the booked gig (200)
Client A still sees the booking with its title (200)

exec: pm.test('Booking history is intact', () => { const b = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('bookingId')); pm.expect(b).to.exist; pm.expect(b.gigTitle).to.eql('Logo design'); });
pm.test('Income is at least the first booking', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.totalIncome).to.be.at.least(pm.collectionVariables.get('gigPrice')));
